name: len
meaning: the length of an array

name: rows
meaning: the outer length of a matrix

name: cols
meaning: the inner length of a matrix, every row's

name: bound
meaning: the exclusive upper bound of an index: it is valid for every array of length at least bound

name: value
meaning: a size value itself, a size name of the environment

name: trips
meaning: the number of trip binders (loops, tabulates) around a node, which a work bound limits

name: depth
meaning: the transcendental depth: the most transcendental functions nested on a path

name: order
meaning: the Horton-Strahler stream order of an expression tree

name: fam
meaning: the family of a node's operation: 0 none, 1 sum, 2 product

name: arm
meaning: the greatest stream order among the arms of a family chain

name: ties
meaning: how many arms of a family chain reach its greatest stream order

name: width
meaning: the number of components of a vector

name: space
meaning: the address space of a pointer

name: access
meaning: the access mode of a pointer

name: uniform
meaning: the value, or the control flow, is the same in every invocation of a workgroup

name: owned
meaning: the value is distinct in every invocation of a dispatch (injective in the invocation id), so a store through it is written by one invocation

name: local_owned
meaning: the value is distinct in every invocation of a workgroup (injective in the local invocation index), so a store into workgroup memory through it is one invocation's

name: work
meaning: the product of the trip counts of the loops around a node, which a work bound limits

name: number
meaning: grammatical number

name: person
meaning: grammatical person

name: sorted
meaning: the array is sorted ascending

name: shape
meaning: the length of each axis of an n-dimensional array, outermost first (host only)
